channel.title: Hastings Daily: Crime & courts
channel.description: Local news for Hastings, St Leonards, Rye, Bexhill and Battle, three times a day.

item.title: Man found not guilty of sex offences on Camber Sands beach
item.description: A man from Kent has been found not guilty of a number of sexual offences against a woman on Camber Sands.

item.title: Manhunt for escaped prisoner with links to Sussex
item.description: Police have launched a manhunt for a convicted prisoner with links to Sussex who escaped from a medical facility in South London on Friday.

item.title: Police secure closure order for Hastings property
item.description: Officers from the Hastings Neighbourhood Policing Team have secured a Closure Order for a property in Cornwallis Terrace, Hastings.
